intro: Understand booking details and basic accommodation rules. Read the French first; open the translation when you want to check your understanding.

texto: Understand booking details and basic accommodation rules. First look for names, days, places and figures: in notices and forms these are usually easy to find.
Point to note: dates show check-in and check-out; « compris » specifies which services are included. In this passage, «réservation» means «booking».

frases.estudio: La réservation de Nora est pour une chambre double, du 12 au 14 juin.
frases.alumno: Nora's booking is for a double room, from 12 to 14 June.

frases.estudio: Le petit déjeuner est compris et servi de sept à dix heures.
frases.alumno: Breakfast is included and served from seven to ten.
